title: Higher-dimensional Kakeya conjecture
exact_target: For every dimension $n\geq4$, must every subset of $\mathbb R^n$ containing a unit segment in each direction have full dimension $n$ in the Kakeya conjecture? The question covers all higher dimensions, not only one fixed dimension.
